# Structured Generation in Practice

## Overview of Today's Practical Session

- Introduction to the Outlines library
- Implementing JSON schema constraints
- Comparing structured vs. traditional generation
- Building financial data generators
- Hands-on experience with real examples

## Session Structure

### Focus: Outlines Library (60 minutes)
- Install Outlines library and dependencies
- Basic structured generation examples
- Understanding constraints and schemas
- Financial data generation with validation
- Performance comparison and analysis

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this session, you will be able to:

- Use the Outlines library for structured LLM generation
- Define and implement JSON schemas for financial data
- Compare the benefits of structured vs. traditional generation
- Create reliable, parseable outputs from LLMs

## Prerequisites

- Python environment with GPU access (recommended)
- Basic understanding of JSON schemas
- Familiarity with LLM APIs
